The use of "tavernkeeper" as opposed to "innkeeper" may cause some conflicts and confusion. I don't recall tavernkeeper used by RJ (maybe he did and I've forgotten) but certainly BS is using tavernkeeper frequently in ToM and maybe we need to create this occupation? For future template use throughout WoT. [[User:Ronmamita|Ronmamita]] 09:21, October 4, 2010 (UTC)
:Most occupations will automatically categorize with the inclusion of the {{tl|Character}} template. It may be a red link, but it categorizes. This works great, the red bothered me and I guess we must capitalize the first letter; this coding is new for me. Thank you! Sincerely, [[User:Ronmamita|Ronmamita]] 19:57, October 4, 2010 (UTC)
:Actually, as far as the template is concerned, capitalization doesn't matter. It just looks better. What the character template does is take the occupation and adds an "s" to it. So "occupation=Tavernkeeper" categorizes as "Category:Tavernkeepers." ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 20:03, October 4, 2010 (UTC)
